entries.title: Russian dissident artist Semyon Skrepezki murdered in Poland
entries.snippet: Skrepezki was known for his scathing caricatures of Russian President Vladimir Putin. His suspected killer has been apprehended.

entries.title: Strait of Hormuz: German military prepares for possible deployment
entries.snippet: Following the tentative deal with the US, Iran is planning to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The German Bundeswehr is planning to assist with the mine-clearing.

entries.snippet: Israel's foreign minister says he is severing contact with the EU's foreign affairs chief Kaja Kallas. Gideon Saar attributed the move to a media report alleging that Kallas compared Israel to apartheid-era South Africa.

entries.title: Oil nations on edge in the face of new climate coalition
entries.snippet: Even amid an ongoing energy crunch, major economies are dodging firm timelines to phase out coal, oil and gas. Fossil fuel-producing nations now fear new clean energy alliances could ramp up the pressure to go green.

entries.title: How a feel-good German song is taking over social media

entries.title: Niger security forces battle gunmen at airport
entries.snippet: Niger's security forces engaged in an hours-long shootout with gunmen at the nation's main international airport. No one has taken responsibility but Islamists are suspected of being behind the attack.

entries.title: Poland: Arrest after Russian artist and Putin critic killed
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Donald Tusk says Lublin police arrested a suspect in the fatal shooting of the Russian national and critical artist known as Semyon Skrepetsky. He said investigators were still seeking a "mastermind."

entries.title: Berlin summit brings out private equity protesters

entries.title: Nathaniel Brown: The left back Germany have been waiting for

entries.title: Cuba approves economic reforms amid US pressure
entries.snippet: Cuba's Communist Party has signed off on a package of free market reforms. One member called the changes a response to "economic war," while the party said they were not a "deviation" from the socialist project.

entries.title: Germany news: Minister weighs cuts to UN contributions
entries.snippet: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul has criticized the UN after Germany failed in a recent bid for a Security Council seat. Meanwhile, industrial employment levels in the country are at a decade low.

entries.title: How a Belarusian exile vanished in waters held by Russia

entries.title: Germany's foreign minister: 'European unity is decisive'
